method: ENTIRELY from ONE AMH page, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED. No passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable and every statement must be verified by a person against a current subscription. ⚠️ AMH states MANY INSTITUTIONS HAVE SPECIFIC PROTOCOLS FOR TREATING HYPERKALAEMIA AND HYPOKALAEMIA AND THAT ITS INFORMATION IS A GUIDE ONLY. That caveat is carried as the guideline's first line. ⚠️ NO mg OR mmol DOSE OF ANY TREATMENT DRUG APPEARS ON THE PAGE -- for calcium it says CHECK LOCAL PROTOCOLS TO GUIDE DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION. The serum-concentration THRESHOLDS are given and are recorded as dose claims because they set treatment decisions.

claims.claim: ⚠️ AMH'S OWN CAVEAT: MANY INSTITUTIONS HAVE SPECIFIC PROTOCOLS FOR TREATING HYPERKALAEMIA AND HYPOKALAEMIA; THE INFORMATION IN AMH IS A GUIDE ONLY
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Potassium is the MAJOR INTRACELLULAR CATION, mainly in skeletal muscle; ⚠️ ONLY 2% OF TOTAL BODY POTASSIUM IS IN THE EXTRACELLULAR FLUID. VERY SMALL CHANGES IN THE INTRACELLULAR/EXTRACELLULAR DISTRIBUTION CAN LEAD TO MAJOR CHANGES IN SERUM/PLASMA LEVELS, which may alter the resting membrane potential of excitable tissues and cause ARRHYTHMIAS AND MUSCLE DYSFUNCTION
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ SERUM POTASSIUM MAY NOT REFLECT TOTAL BODY POTASSIUM. ACUTE CHANGES ARE USUALLY DUE TO INTRACELLULAR/EXTRACELLULAR SHIFT RATHER THAN A CHANGE IN TOTAL BODY POTASSIUM, and concentration SHOULD BE INTERPRETED RELATIVE TO ARTERIAL OR VENOUS pH because metabolic acid-base status affects transcellular shift and renal loss. ⚠️ SERUM CONCENTRATIONS ARE OFTEN SLIGHTLY HIGHER THAN PLASMA CONCENTRATIONS due to in-vitro contamination by intracellular red blood cell potassium
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ SEVERE HYPERKALAEMIA -- SERUM POTASSIUM ABOVE 6.0 mmol/L -- IS A MEDICAL EMERGENCY THAT CAN CAUSE MUSCLE WEAKNESS, ARRHYTHMIAS AND/OR CARDIAC ARREST. It is MOST COMMONLY CAUSED BY RENAL FAILURE AND IS RARE WHEN RENAL FUNCTION IS NORMAL
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Other causes of hyperkalaemia: DRUGS THAT INCREASE POTASSIUM CONCENTRATION -- potassium supplements, potassium-sparing diuretics, ACE INHIBITORS, NSAIDs, TRIMETHOPRIM -- TISSUE DAMAGE OR BREAKDOWN such as trauma, burns, haemolysis and rhabdomyolysis, and ACIDOSIS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: WHEN TO START TREATMENT: START IMMEDIATELY IF THERE ARE ECG CHANGES CONSISTENT WITH SEVERE HYPERKALAEMIA. ⚠️ IN THE ABSENCE OF SYMPTOMS OR ECG CHANGES, FIRST EXCLUDE SPURIOUS HYPERKALAEMIA -- eg A HAEMOLYSED SPECIMEN OR HIGH PLATELET COUNT -- BEFORE STARTING TREATMENT
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: STABILISE THE CARDIAC CELL MEMBRANE: CALCIUM GLUCONATE OR CALCIUM CHLORIDE BY IV INJECTION counters the cardiac effects of raised potassium. ⚠️ CHECK LOCAL PROTOCOLS TO GUIDE DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION -- AMH GIVES NO DOSE. EFFECTS SHOULD BEGIN WITHIN A FEW MINUTES AND LAST 30-60 MINUTES; REPEAT IF NECESSARY. Calcium gluconate is LESS IRRITANT and contains LESS CALCIUM PER GRAM than calcium chloride
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ WHEN TREATING HYPERKALAEMIA DUE TO DIGOXIN TOXICITY, SEEK ADVICE FROM A TOXICOLOGIST OR A POISONS INFORMATION CENTRE ON 13 11 26. MANUFACTURERS OF CALCIUM INJECTIONS CONTRAINDICATE USE WITH DIGOXIN, BUT SPECIALISTS MAY USE THEM IN DIGOXIN TOXICITY
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: PROMOTE CELLULAR UPTAKE: IV GLUCOSE AND INSULIN promote cellular uptake of potassium -- THE EFFECTS OF INSULIN SHOULD BEGIN WITHIN 10-20 MINUTES AND LAST 4-6 HOURS, and GLUCOSE IS NOT REQUIRED IF HYPERGLYCAEMIC. SALBUTAMOL, NEBULISED AND RARELY IV, causes potassium to shift into cells and may be added -- USUALLY ONLY SHORT TERM IN PATIENTS WITH ONGOING SYMPTOMS OR SERIOUS ECG CHANGES AFTER CALCIUM AND INSULIN/GLUCOSE THERAPY
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: IV SODIUM BICARBONATE may be used to lower potassium IN SEVERE ACIDOSIS; ⚠️ CAUTION IN PATIENTS WITH FLUID OVERLOAD OR HEART FAILURE, and RAPID ALKALINISATION MAY ALSO CAUSE TETANY BY LOWERING CALCIUM CONCENTRATION. ⚠️ DO NOT GIVE CALCIUM AND SODIUM BICARBONATE IN THE SAME IV LINE AS PRECIPITATION MAY OCCUR
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ NONE OF THE MEMBRANE-STABILISING OR CELLULAR-UPTAKE MEASURES REDUCES TOTAL BODY POTASSIUM. Once the emergency has been treated, CONSIDER IV OR ORAL FUROSEMIDE AND FLUID REPLACEMENT WITH SALINE if not in renal failure; HAEMOFILTRATION OR DIALYSIS MAY BE NECESSARY
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: POLYSTYRENE SULFONATE RESINS will SLIGHTLY increase potassium excretion ⚠️ ALTHOUGH THEIR EFFECTIVENESS IS DEBATABLE -- any effect TAKES SOME HOURS, repeated dosing may be required, and IT IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR EMERGENCY MEASURES OR DIALYSIS. PATIROMER is a cation exchange polymer whose ONSET MAY TAKE UP TO 7 HOURS after oral administration; ⚠️ IT IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR EMERGENCY MEASURES AND LONG-TERM SAFETY AND EFFICACY DATA ARE LACKING
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: MILD HYPOKALAEMIA -- SERUM POTASSIUM 3.1-3.5 mmol/L -- IS USUALLY ASYMPTOMATIC. ⚠️ SEVERE HYPOKALAEMIA -- BELOW 2.5 mmol/L -- CAN CAUSE MUSCLE WEAKNESS, PALPITATIONS, ARRHYTHMIAS AND/OR SUDDEN CARDIAC DEATH
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ESTABLISH AND TREAT THE UNDERLYING CAUSE of hypokalaemia. POTASSIUM LOSS may be GI (vomiting, diarrhoea), RENAL (diuretics, hyperaldosteronism), SEVERE BURNS or OTHER DRUGS such as corticosteroids. INTRACELLULAR SHIFT is often caused by drugs -- IV INSULIN FOR HYPERGLYCAEMIA, HIGH-DOSE SALBUTAMOL. ⚠️ REDUCED ORAL POTASSIUM INTAKE RARELY CAUSES HYPOKALAEMIA ON ITS OWN IN HEALTHY PEOPLE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ CHECK SERUM MAGNESIUM AND REPLACE IF DEFICIENT -- HYPOKALAEMIA MAY BE REFRACTORY TO TREATMENT IF HYPOMAGNESAEMIA IS PRESENT
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: SEVERE ACUTE POTASSIUM LOSS may require IV treatment, especially if symptomatic. ⚠️ GIVE IV SLOWLY AS A THOROUGHLY MIXED, DILUTE SOLUTION TO AVOID LIFE-THREATENING ARRHYTHMIAS. MONITOR SERUM POTASSIUM FREQUENTLY -- and fluid balance if giving large volumes -- AND MONITOR ECG
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: In CHRONIC LOSS and less urgent hypokalaemia the usual ORAL SUPPLEMENT IS POTASSIUM CHLORIDE. ⚠️ ROUTINE USE OF ORAL POTASSIUM SUPPLEMENTS WITH THIAZIDE DIURETICS USED TO TREAT HYPERTENSION IS NOT RECOMMENDED, as potassium loss is usually small; USE OF POTASSIUM-SPARING AGENTS SUCH AS ACE INHIBITORS OR POTASSIUM-SPARING DIURETICS IS PREFERRED. ADVISE PATIENTS TO TAKE ORAL POTASSIUM CHLORIDE WITH A MEAL AND PLENTY OF FLUID TO REDUCE THE RISK OF GI IRRITATION
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Potassium disturbances' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/blood-electrolytes/drugs-electrolyte-imbalance/drugs-potassium-imbalance/potassium-disturbances, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22
